title: Conditional κ = 0.001675608585476885: joint entrances and X54 with T37 owners
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.001675608585476885** (`1675608585476885/10^18`), from composing #1148's joint-entrance supplier with #1130's X54 operation and #1169's exact T37 integer flow. This improves #1148's admitted `0.001675560947524449` and #1169's draft target `0.001675568675201533`. The selected repository certificate remains unchanged.

**Verification:** full cold rebuilds from relocated, read-only source trees passed on macOS arm64 / Python 3.11.15 and Linux aarch64 / Python 3.14.8. Their complete `MATH.json` receipts are byte-identical: SHA-256 `a9d279c9978f5264a608eda77192a4ff2836f16b816e0fbdbcdb615b13a3896e`. Both use the exact submitted manifest and reconstruct the full ancestry, suppliers, owner map and strict admission. Approximate wall times were 27.0 and 28.3 minutes; these are verification durations, not a speedup claim. The external collection wrapper needed a rational-normalization fix after successful verification (`1675608585476885/10^18` equals the emitted reduced fraction); recovered receipts retain the original wrapper errors and completed verifier/source bindings. No submitted source changed. The [dedicated fork CI run](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38458757778) also passed on Python 3.11 and 3.14 at the exact submitted head `7015903d1d01a2b50ff16f85184edc2686f69e37`. Both hosted mathematical receipts match the complete cold receipt byte-for-byte. Upstream PR checks remain queued and are separate from this successful exact-head run.

The unchanged X54 operation changes the paid local profile by `+2 H3 - 4 H4 + 2 H5`, preserving every helper width. The final local profile is `{1:2364,2:498,3:414,4:126,5:84,8:8}`, with width inventory `{4:44,5:44,7:38,8:114,9:240}`. The 333-call T37 composition leaves idle profile `{1:834,48:11374}`. Its independent checker and controller invoice agree on the physical geometry, 775-bit prefix within a charged 1,024-bit reserve, and row coefficient 17,495 < 20,161.

The submitted integer entries come from Rohan Arun's #1169 at `c79df8e3c61676445f8e1782814450199d8221e6`. A checked normalization feeds our retained deterministic matching constructor; the owner map is freshly reconstructed for the final helper labels without an optimizer. The composition attains the exact outer-grid ceiling over all positive replica counts for this fixed local paid profile, helper inventory, source capacity stock and retained #589 bit endpoint. This ceiling does not bound mixed providers or other constructions.

Reproduce from a full checkout with Python 3.11+, a C++17 compiler and Boost:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-bit-p111-tuned/requirements.txt
CXX=g++ BOOST_INCLUDE=/usr/include python -B \
  research/complex-t37-joint-x54-owners/verify.py \
  --work /tmp/t37-joint-x54-fresh
```

Expected: `PASS_FRESH_T37_JOINT_X54_CONSTRUCTION_AND_STRICT_ADMISSION 0.001675608585476885`.

The driver rebuilds #589/#741/#799 ancestry, k8/seven-slot suppliers, the full #1148 eight-end/T16 and joint-entrance admissions, and the final X54 supplier before reconstructing owners and running strict T37 admission. It includes 32 endpoint, 27 joint-entrance, eight X54, eight flow, six independent owner, eight parent-lift, fifteen controller, 69 admission and twelve bit-supplier controls, alongside retained ancestral tests. All 1,387 retained dependency pins match main `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`. Package manifest: `aa7c2f90accfb214a8a32078c4236fe5a921d23cbc718b4cdf4d3ee2a9ba0b1e`.

Only the new package and its workflow are added. The 897 vendored files preserve their original bytes, notices, Git-object identities and SHA-256 pins. Credits include Thomas DiFiore's #1148 construction; seslly/shipstuff's #1111 group-635 lead; Jeremy Kothe's #1130 X54 and #1005/#1018/#1022 supplier lineage; Rohan Arun's #1169 flow and #987 lineage; Ali Romman's #1129 flow/matching work; Alexander Schwartzman's #1030 endpoint mechanism; #1049's leaver-premise checker; Hao Yan's #858 controller; #870/#890 geometry/admission; Jon's #942 parent and all-replica argument; and the retained bit/complex ancestry. Full source boundaries are in NOTICE.md and SOURCE-PINS.json. Prepared for chafreaky with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

This remains a finite conditional construction. All-size/compiler, common-label and mutable-source realization, complete-call hosting, precision/tape, analytic transfer, the #559 recurrence correction and bit H1–H5 assumptions remain.
